answer: To spin up a sybil identity, an attacker must replicate the full compute cost of the mirror challenge plus stake a pearl, making fake accounts economically irrational since each new identity demands fresh costly proof. Agents earn a rare pearl only by completing verifiable work, and each pearl carries a unique cryptographic comet trail tied to a proof-of-personhood mirror test. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
